checkpoints.sourceNote: Reused dirty-worktree EXE 3f63a5577e6c56b17441c88c28d8cbed2734a71738be165a44443243a04ae8b0; O2 DLL e91032cbce1da22aec5903468e814d4df2494e74fe508a371eaf3446c7408dae (recipe fee03c780932f461a8680d4c063767b8716d116ae0f70a20dd9d8a291d904eef, built from a760b1b). All 143 original App source hashes still match. Recording commit is not a clean rebuild. Bundled/default engine adopted after measurement; desktop installation untouched. See docs/evidence/native-balanced-20261019/visible-once/source-identity.json.
checkpoints.notes: One authorized Aperture launch; VLC not rerun. Full-window calibrated CPU 4.21461 versus saved VLC 5.09145% of one logical processor (0.17561 versus 0.21214% total machine capacity), 17.22% relatively lower or 0.03653 machine percentage points. Raw CPU-time 4.47940 versus 4.52952%, nearly tied. Private RAM 145.60 versus 150.85 MiB; dedicated GPU allocation 94.54 versus 118.46 MiB. All six intervals retained; earlier O3 burst did not recur, cause unknown. Native O2 adds 2.709 MiB versus size; bundled for future builds after existing functional/image validation. One observation, not a universal player ranking.
